ONESIGNAL_APP_ID.description: OneSignal says the App ID is safe to use in client-side SDK initialisation and is not a secret, calling it and the Organization ID public identifiers. The variable name is convention.

ONESIGNAL_API_KEY.description: OneSignal says App and Organization API keys are private secrets, never to be exposed in client code or committed to a public repository.

ONESIGNAL_ORG_API_KEY.description: Reaches every app in the organisation, so OneSignal asks for extra care and says to share it only with services that need that reach.
